content:
anna_sales: OrchidHealth RFI just arrived. Key asks: 4-week Dedicated POC, embeddings + chat capability matrix, explicit KMS/HSM support, SOC2/BAA evidence, and a clear fallback policy example. Uploaded orchid_rfi_oct2024.pdf. Need a draft package by EOD tomorrow.

jordan_se: For sizing: they note intermittent bursts ~250 QPS. Suggest we propose 2x A10 baseline for the POC with option to scale to 4x for stress windows. Which do we want to include as the default? @maria_ps will you own perf?
maria_ps: I will own perf. If they can't share a scrubbed corpus we'll run a synthetic generator matching token lengths and distribution. Need target p99 (suggest we propose <150ms as a starting ask). Also confirm whether chat uses long-context ( >2k tokens ).

zoe_finance: Provisional POC pricing (for RFI only): 2x A10 baseline + managed ops ~ $44,000 for 4 weeks (clearly mark as provisional, subject to discount/contract approval).
sam_security: Security note: Hosted supports tenant key separation and customer-managed keys (CMEK) for some clouds; HSM-backed keys are available only on Private deployments via partner HSM (CloudHSM / Google HSM / YubiHSM) and require a contract addendum and key-rotation SOP. I'll draft the KMS/HSM appendix and flag any legal caveats.

legal_lee: Do not state FedRAMP authorization. We can provide our control mapping and SOC2 Type II evidence for current scope; for expanded scope we provide interim attestations and a timeline. Also call out that BAA is required for PHI and must be executed before POC with PHI data.

jordan_se: Quick capability matrix CSV (paste for RFI):

```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Chat,Yes,Yes,Yes
Customer KMS (CMEK),Partial,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional(Private),Partner integration
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise
Fallback policy,Region spill,Policy-driven,Policy-driven+notice
```

anna_sales: Can @jordan_se draft a 2-3 sentence fallback policy example we can include? Also I'll request scrubbed sample + p99 target from OrchidHealth. Reviewers: @maria_ps @sam_security @zoe_finance @legal_lee. Please flag edits by 2pm PT tomorrow.

doc-bot: Uploaded: orchid_rfi_response_stub.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1769999999/orchid_rfi_response_stub.pdf

anna_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble the draft and mark provisional items and blockers in the cover email.
